children: Essent Group’s third-quarter revenue rose year over year, while net income edged lower. Growth in investment income, other invested asset returns and other income—including a lower embedded-derivative liability—was offset by higher loss provisions, including property and casualty reinsurance claims and aging mortgage defaults.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Segment pretax income was $185.3M, up from $184.4M; higher investment and other income offset increased loss provisions and lower premiums earned.
: Segment pretax income fell to $17.5M from $20.1M as property and casualty reinsurance expanded premiums and loss provisions.
: NIW was $12.1B, compared with $12.2B; ending insurance in force reached $250.1B, up from $248.8B.
: Net investment income rose to $63.0M from $59.8M, supported by higher yields and a larger average cash and available-for-sale portfolio.
: The loss ratio increased to 24.5% from 20.5%, reflecting more insured loans in default and higher average reserves per default.
